notes.body: Strong scoping call. Priya wants to expand seats at renewal. Straightforward.

notes.author: S. Dutta
notes.body: Priya replied re: scoping and mentioned almost in passing that she is moving to a new role internally at the end of the quarter and 'someone from the platform team will pick this up'. She did not say who. Everything in this deal has run through Priya.

notes.author: S. Dutta
notes.body: Sent proposal v2 to Priya. No reply yet. I have not been introduced to a successor.

investigation.root_cause: The deal's primary contact (champion), Priya Raman, is transitioning to a new internal role and a successor has not been identified or introduced to the seller, leading to a complete halt in communication and progress.

evidence.claim: The primary contact, Priya Raman, is moving to a new internal role at the end of the quarter, and an unknown successor from the platform team is expected to take over.
All deal interactions have been exclusively through Priya Raman, indicating a single point of contact.
The seller has sent a proposal to Priya but has not received a reply and has not been introduced to a successor.
There has been no customer engagement for 24 days and the primary contact has been silent for 24 days, coinciding with the announcement of her internal role change and lack of successor.
The deal is single-threaded, with only Priya Raman engaged as a contact, despite its significant value.

contradicting_evidence: The initial interactions with Priya Raman were positive, with her expressing interest in expanding seats (NOTE-5201). This suggests the deal was not stuck due to disinterest but rather an internal change.
unknowns: The specific identity of Priya Raman's successor from the platform team.
The exact date Priya Raman will fully transition out of her current role and disengage from the deal.
The internal process at Contoso Ltd for transferring deal ownership and responsibilities.

proposal.recommended_action: Escalate this deal to sales leadership for guidance on how to identify a new champion at Contoso Ltd. The primary contact, Priya Raman, is transitioning to a new internal role, has gone silent, and no successor has been identified to the seller.
proposal.rationale: The deal is stalled because the sole point of contact, Priya Raman, is leaving her role, and a successor has not been identified or introduced. This deal is single-threaded and significant in value ($95,000). The current close date is unrealistic. Escalating will allow sales leadership to strategize on identifying a new champion at Contoso Ltd and re-engaging to save the deal, rather than continuing to email a transitioning contact or letting the deal stagnate without a clear path forward.

crm_updates.reason: The current close date of 2026-10-17 is unrealistic given that the primary contact has gone silent due to an internal role change and no successor has been identified. This date has already slipped twice, and a new, more realistic date is needed to reflect the current stalled state and the significant effort required to re-establish contact and progress the deal.
